text: Netarhat is a hill station in Latehar district in the Indian state of Jharkhand. The hill station is among the highest points of the Chotanagpur plateau. It is known for the natural beauty of hills, forest and waterfalls. It is also referred to as the "Queen of Chotanagpur".
best_time: October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks)
